attributes.altText: Data center fiber cabling with MPO trunk cassettes

attributes.text: What it is

Everything between the street and the final rack hop is passive. Outside plant cable arrives, gets spliced in the meet-me room from outdoor jacket to plenum or riser rated, and runs as factory-terminated trunk through the main, horizontal and equipment distribution areas. Only at the last hop does an active transceiver appear. Get the passive layer wrong and no transceiver fixes it.
Product codes
MPO and MTP trunk, LC and SC patch, cassettes and adapters, rollable ribbon ISP
Fiber type
OS2 single-mode, OM3 and OM4 multimode
Fiber counts
12F to 864F, 144F per 1U
Construction
Factory terminated trunk, harness breakout, modular cassette
Jacket and protection
Plenum and riser rated, armored optional, low smoke zero halogen
Deployment
MMR, MDA, HDA, EDA, rack
Lead time
6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds, staged delivery available
Trunk counts and panel density
Trunk counts sized to the zone they serve, terminated at the factory so nothing gets spliced on site that does not have to be.

Data center fiber cabling FAQ
OS2 or OM4, which should we specify?
OS2 single-mode for distance, OM3 and OM4 multimode for short reach inside a row. The deciding factor is the link budget on the longest run in the zone, not what the last build used.
How much fiber fits in 1U?
144F in a fixed 1U unit, built as twelve modular cassettes. An 864F rollable ribbon trunk feeds a stack of them.
Which MPO polarity do you supply?
Type A, B and C are all available, specified per order. Tell us the polarity method your patching scheme uses and the trunks are built to match.
Can delivery be staged to our build phases?

Yes. Large orders are commonly split across phases so cable is not sitting on site months before the racks land. Lead time is 6 to 8 weeks from PO on the first tranche, up to 10 weeks for custom builds.
What is the difference between MPO and MTP?
MPO is the multi-fiber connector standard. MTP is one manufacturer’s version, built to tighter tolerances and intermateable with standard MPO. Every MTP is an MPO. Not every MPO is an MTP.
Does the trunk I need depend on my switch brand?
No. It depends on the transceiver at each end. A 40G or 100G SR4 module uses 8 of the 12 fibers in an MPO, and two switches from different vendors running the same optics take the same trunk.
What is a fiber optic trunk cable?

A fiber optic trunk cable is a factory-terminated, multi-fiber assembly that carries many fibers between two distribution points, such as the main and horizontal distribution areas of a data center. MTP and MPO trunk cable comes in 12 to 864 fibers with Type A, B or C polarity and breaks out to duplex LC through cassettes or harnesses. Standard lead time is 6 to 8 weeks.
Do you hold US inventory?

No. Vocom is build-to-order with no US warehouse, so every cable is built to your specification. Standard lead time is 6 to 8 weeks, expedited air freight is 2 to 3 weeks, and high-count or custom builds take up to 10 weeks. Delivery can be staged to your build phases.
Can contractors order cable and assemblies for furnish-and-install work?

Yes. Contractors who carry material in their scope can order cable and assemblies directly. Send the fiber count, fiber type, footage and needed-by date, and we will return a price and a delivery date.
What fiber does an AI data center build need?

AI and GPU cluster builds are cabled with high-density MPO and MTP trunks between halls and rows, indoor rollable ribbon for backbone runs where pathway space is tight, and duplex LC patching at the rack. Send the fiber counts, polarity method and needed-by date and we will quote it as a build-to-order.
Can you meet GPU cluster build schedules?

Standard lead time is 6 to 8 weeks from PO, expedited air freight is 2 to 3 weeks, and high-count or custom builds take up to 10 weeks, with delivery staged to your build phases. Indoor rollable ribbon runs to 864F in plenum and riser ratings.
What is the difference between OFNP and OFNR?

OFNP is plenum rated for air handling spaces. OFNR is riser rated for vertical runs between floors. Plenum is the stricter rating, and the inspecting authority decides which one applies to your pathway. State it on the order rather than assuming it.
Which indoor fiber optic cables do you supply?

Mini cable in 8F and 12F with 3.0mm OD and OFNP rating, indoor rollable ribbon from 12F to 864F in plenum and riser ratings, armored indoor drop, and MPO and MTP trunks and patch cords for the data hall. Any spec can be built to order.
Can you supply high-count indoor cable?
Yes. Indoor rollable ribbon runs from 12F to 864F with plenum and riser options, built to order. For other counts, send the spec and we will quote it as a custom build.
Need a Fiber Built to Your Exact Specification?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any fiber optic cable to match your spec.
